history.zh: 2026-10-15，整合 I3b（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述（新核心模块 Becoming.Granularity，新桥接 Becoming.GranularityBridge）。块是同一展开的有限路径（Frame.blocks），块的历史即写出的较细历史（Frame.blocks_trace_iff）；块的每个分支检验都是较细检验，在相同配置成立，不加前提（Frame.holds_blocks）。在较细粒度相同或同测的配置在块中亦然（Alike.blocks、SameBranchingTests.blocks）；每个较细动作自成一块时，块的检验恢复每个较细检验（Frame.blocks_sameBranchingTests_iff，充分非必要），两种描述的核相同（Frame.blocks_kernel_iff）。以另一粒度读同一展开的一般律：两框架的检验各自译入较细框架、译文在两配置处一致、接收侧每步结果列出时，前者的每段历史由后者以相同步匹配，终点译文仍一致（Translates.history_matches_of_em）；排中律为具名假设 em，外围的经典推理正在此处；列出的结果给出每段有限路径的终点，不用选择（outcomes_of_trace）。保留引用的块保持起点并计入其中每次形成（Joining.retained_blocks_extend，外围的登记模型编译后用 propext，故在核心的保留框架上重述）。桥接表明外围的块即核心的（blocks_ofModel，按定义），编译问题即较细检验（BranchingTest.toTest_finer）：compile_correct、blocks_trace_iff、singleton_coverage_recovers_questions、full_and_block_reduced_kernels 逐字成立，不加假设；finite_trace_endpoints 与 blocks_image_finite 外围以经典选择证明，核心不用选择；cross_granularity_history_matches 以 em 为假设。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 15 October 2026, integration I3b (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine (new core module Becoming.Granularity, new bridge Becoming.GranularityBridge). A block is a finite course of the same unfolding (Frame.blocks), and a history of blocks is the finer history written out (Frame.blocks_trace_iff); every branching test of blocks is a finer test holding at the same configurations, with no premise (Frame.holds_blocks). Configurations alike, or passing the same tests, at the finer grain are so in blocks (Alike.blocks, SameBranchingTests.blocks); where every finer move is a block of its own, the tests of blocks recover every finer test (Frame.blocks_sameBranchingTests_iff, sufficient, not necessary) and two descriptions have one kernel (Frame.blocks_kernel_iff). The general law of reading one unfolding at another grain: where the tests of two frames translate into finer frames, the translations agree at two configurations and each move of the receiving side has listed outcomes, every history of the first is matched by one of the second by the same steps, ending where the translations agree again (Translates.history_matches_of_em); excluded middle is the named hypothesis em, which is where the periphery reasoned classically, and listed outcomes give the endpoints of every finite course with no choice (outcomes_of_trace). Blocks of retained references keep where the course started and count every formation within (Joining.retained_blocks_extend, restated on the core’s retained frame because the periphery’s register model compiles through propext). The bridge shows the periphery’s blocks are the core’s (blocks_ofModel, by definition) and its compiled questions the finer tests (BranchingTest.toTest_finer): compile_correct, blocks_trace_iff, singleton_coverage_recovers_questions and full_and_block_reduced_kernels hold as stated with no added hypothesis; finite_trace_endpoints and blocks_image_finite, chosen classically in the periphery, need no choice in the core; cross_granularity_history_matches holds with em. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proofs and their receipts keep their scope.

title.zh: 有限操作粒度的问答翻译与历史恢复
title.en: Question translation and history recovery across finite operation scales

claim.zh: 有限宏步骤的全部分支问题精确翻译为原生问题；两边展开方案可用不同事件及步数，初始翻译问答一致且接收侧有限分支，即可匹配任意有限宏历史并保留终点问答。保留引用的原配置及内部形成数得到保持；单步覆盖接通原生／宏约简编码核。
claim.en: All finite-block branch questions translate exactly into native questions. Expansions may use different events and lengths; complete initial translated-answer agreement and receiving-side finite branching match every finite block history with final answers preserved. Retained configurations keep original references and internal formation counts; singleton coverage aligns full/block reduced encoding kernels.

hypotheses.zh: 给定过程、有限展开词、同一宏步骤及原子问题的解释；跨表述历史恢复需完整翻译问答一致与接收侧 ImageFinite。
hypotheses.en: Supplied processes, finite expansion words and interpretation of common block/atomic questions; cross-articulation history recovery needs complete translated-answer agreement and receiving-side ImageFinite.

hypotheses.zh: 引用保持应用使用原有追加式配置语义；核相等另需每个原生事件有单步名称及两份说明各自 Exact、Reduced。
hypotheses.en: Reference preservation uses existing append-only configuration semantics; kernel equality additionally needs singleton names for all native events and Exact/Reduced for each presentation.

correspondence.zh: 宏步骤由同一原过程的 Trace 构成，共享实际边界。跨过程问题的实际对应仍给定，不声称中间位置已经一一对应。
correspondence.en: Blocks are Trace paths of the same native process with actual shared boundaries. Actual cross-process question correspondence remains supplied; no bijection of internal positions is inferred.

detail.zh: 复用后继匹配，单向历史只需接收侧有限性。
detail.en: Reuse successor matching; one-way history lifting only needs receiving-side finiteness.

output.zh: 有限问题一致迫出后继匹配。
output.en: Equal finite-test answers force successor matching.

input.zh: 有限展开端点得到 ImageFinite，逐步接到 cross_granularity_history_matches。
input.en: Finite expansion endpoints give ImageFinite, consumed stepwise by cross_granularity_history_matches.

conditions.zh: 完整宏问答一致；展开是固定有限词。
conditions.en: Complete block-question agreement; expansions are fixed finite words.

detail.zh: 复用配置保持及内部步数定理。
detail.en: Reuse retained configurations and internal step counting.

input.zh: retained_block_provenance 将宏历史展开为同一配置历史后接用。
input.en: retained_block_provenance flattens blocks into the same configuration trace.
